representation.name: match q1 ABO VCF
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir extract
cd extract
tar -xf "$(inputs.archive.path)"
plink2 --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr 9 --from-bp 133250000 --to-bp 133280000 --export vcf --out abo11
plink2 --pfile match.genotypes.1.3 --chr 9 --from-bp 133250000 --to-bp 133280000 --export vcf --out abo13
cp abo11.vcf ../abo11.vcf
cp abo13.vcf ../abo13.vcf
